source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: You know the hidden arteries of urban life: back alleys, service passages, and unmonitored shortcuts most residents never find. You and companions you lead travel at double speed through any settlement while not in combat. When you take the Hide action in an urban environment with at least 10 people present you do so with advantage, as you know how to vanish into a crowd.
